environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7.x application deployed on AWS ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer. Session management uses default in-memory HttpSession with JSESSIONID cookie (SameSite not explicitly set, defaults to Lax in modern browsers but the application is accessed via a custom Electron desktop client that does not enforce SameSite). ALB has no WAF attached. The application serves both the admin UI and the REST API on the same origin. No custom CSRF token validation. No Origin/Referer header checking.
